race.description: Mallee Dipping & Mulesing/Zadow Well Drillers/A1 Jet Cleaning Hcp (54)
race.comment: ENCIPHERING (3) stepped back in distance and did a good job to work home well into a distant second over 1350m at Strathalbyn last start. Better placed out to this trip and with a bit of luck from the wide alley he can play a key role. Greybeard EASY BEAST (9) was game in defeat after leading two runs back over 2000m at Naracoorte. Too bad to be true in a similar race at Murray Bridge last time. Nicely in after the claim and can bounce back off a 32-day reset. SAZERAC (12) scored over 1500m two back at Bordertown before a poor effort more recently at Gawler. Might be looking for this sort of journey now. CITY GOLD READY (4) gets to a good track for the first time this prep and might be the big improver.
